info.name: Campground Booking
info.description:
Campground Booking API (SW Dev Project #2, Group 2 Teletubbies).

Run `node seeder -i` first, select the **Campground Booking** environment, then run the folders in order.

item.name: Register new user (role in body is ignored)
Get me - new user is a regular user

exec: pm.test("Role is user even though role=admin was sent", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.role).to.eql("user"));

item.name: Logout (revokes the token and clears the cookie)
Get me without token after logout -> 401
Get me with the logged-out token -> 401
Get campgrounds with an unknown operator -> 400
Get booking with an invalid id -> 400
User1 update own booking to 4 nights -> 400
User1 update own booking to a past date -> 400
Delete booking with an invalid id -> 400
User1 change dates of a completed booking -> 400

exec: pm.test("Sees bookings from more than one user", () => pm.expect(owners.size).to.be.above(1));

item.name: Admin get bookings for one campground

exec: pm.test("All bookings are for this campground", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.campground._id).to.eql(id)));

item.name: User1 change dates of a cancelled booking -> 400
Find the full campground (Mae Sa Hideaway, capacity 1)

exec: const full = json.data.find(c => c.name === "Mae Sa Hideaway");
pm.test("Full campground exists with capacity 1", () => { pm.expect(full).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(full.capacity).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Get the full campground's upcoming booking to find the full date

exec: pm.test("Full campground has a booking", () => pm.expect(booked).to.be.an("object"));
pm.test("Every result is in Chiang Mai", () => json.data.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.province).to.eql("Chiang Mai")));
pm.test("Includes Doi Inthanon Camp and Mae Sa Hideaway", () => { pm.expect(names).to.include("Doi Inthanon Camp"); pm.expect(names).to.include("Mae Sa Hideaway"); });
pm.test("Does not include other provinces", () => pm.expect(names).to.not.include("Railay Beach Camp"));
pm.test("Every result is in the West", () => json.data.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.region).to.eql("West")));
pm.test("Includes Erawan and Sai Yok", () => { pm.expect(names).to.include("Erawan Riverside Camp"); pm.expect(names).to.include("Sai Yok Bamboo Camp"); });

item.name: Filter by province and region together
Filter by a province with no campgrounds -> empty list

exec: pm.test("Finds Erawan Riverside Camp", () => pm.expect(json.data.map(c => c.name)).to.include("Erawan Riverside Camp"));
pm.test("Every result matches the search text", () => json.data.forEach(c => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(c).toLowerCase()).to.include("erawan")));
pm.test("3 campgrounds on the page", () => pm.expect(json.data.length).to.eql(3));
const c = json.data.find(x => x.name === "Doi Inthanon Camp");

item.name: Filter by date excludes the full campground

exec: pm.test("Mae Sa Hideaway is not listed on its full date", () => pm.expect(names).to.not.include("Mae Sa Hideaway"));
pm.test("Other campgrounds are still listed", () => { pm.expect(names).to.include("Doi Inthanon Camp"); pm.expect(names).to.include("Railay Beach Camp"); });

item.name: Filter by a free date still lists the full campground

exec: pm.test("Mae Sa Hideaway is listed", () => pm.expect(json.data.map(c => c.name)).to.include("Mae Sa Hideaway"));

pm.test("Has the 8 seeded provinces", () => pm.expect(json.data.provinces).to.include.members(["Chiang Mai", "Chiang Rai", "Nakhon Ratchasima", "Loei", "Nakhon Nayok", "Rayong", "Kanchanaburi", "Krabi"]));

item.name: Find the full campground (Mae Sa Hideaway, capacity 1)

exec: const full = json.data.find(c => c.name === "Mae Sa Hideaway");
pm.test("Full campground exists with capacity 1", () => { pm.expect(full).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(full.capacity).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Get the full campground's upcoming booking to find the full date

exec: pm.test("Full campground has a booking", () => pm.expect(booked).to.be.an("object"));

item.name: Full campground on a free date is available

exec: pm.test("Available with 1 remaining", () => { pm.expect(d.capacity).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.booked).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.remaining).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.available).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Full campground on its full date has remaining 0

exec: pm.test("Fully booked", () => { pm.expect(d.capacity).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.booked).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.remaining).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.available).to.eql(false); });

item.name: Find "Doi Inthanon Camp" in the seeded data

exec: const found = json.data.find(c => c.name === "Doi Inthanon Camp");
pm.test("Seeded campground Doi Inthanon Camp exists (run node seeder -i)", () => pm.expect(found).to.be.an("object"));

item.name: Large campground on the full date is still available

exec: pm.test("Available with room left", () => { pm.expect(d.capacity).to.eql(12); pm.expect(d.remaining).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d.available).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Availability with an invalid campground id -> 400
Change password with a wrong current password -> 401
Change password with a too-short new password -> 400
Change password (revokes the old token, returns a new one)
The old token no longer works -> 401

exec: pm.test("Details are updated", () => { pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("User One Updated"); pm.expect(d.tel).to.eql("0899999998"); pm.expect(d.email).to.eql("user1.updated@gmail.com"); });

item.name: Get me shows the new details
Update email to one that is already registered -> 400

exec: pm.test("Says the email is already registered", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Email is already registered"));

item.name: Update details with an empty body -> 400
Restore the original name, tel and email

exec: pm.test("Original details are back", () => { pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("User One"); pm.expect(d.tel).to.eql("0811111111"); pm.expect(d.email).to.eql("user1@gmail.com"); });

item.name: Login user1 again (original email and password)
Find "Erawan Riverside Camp" in the seeded data

exec: const found = json.data.find(c => c.name === "Erawan Riverside Camp");
pm.test("Seeded campground Erawan Riverside Camp exists (run node seeder -i)", () => pm.expect(found).to.be.an("object"));

exec: const found = json.data.find(c => c.name === "Doi Inthanon Camp");
pm.test("Seeded campground Doi Inthanon Camp exists (run node seeder -i)", () => pm.expect(found).to.be.an("object"));

item.name: User1 get bookings and find the completed (unreviewed) and upcoming Erawan stays

exec: const erawan = json.data.filter(b => b.campground.name === "Erawan Riverside Camp");
pm.test("User1 has a completed and an upcoming Erawan booking", () => { pm.expect(done).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(next).to.be.an("object"); });

item.name: User2 get bookings and find the completed Khao Yai stay

exec: const done = json.data.find(b => b.status === "completed" && b.campground.name === "Khao Yai Pine Camp");
pm.test("User2 has a completed Khao Yai booking", () => pm.expect(done).to.be.an("object"));
pm.test("Must wait for the stay", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You can only review after your stay"));

item.name: Review a booking for a different campground -> 400
User1 review the completed Erawan booking -> 201

exec: pm.test("Review is for user1 and this booking", () => { pm.expect(d.user).to.eql(pm.environment.get("user1Id")); pm.expect(d.booking).to.eql(pm.environment.get("reviewBookingId")); pm.expect(d.campground).to.eql(pm.environment.get("erawanId")); });
pm.test("Rating and comment saved", () => { pm.expect(d.rating).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.comment).to.eql("Lovely riverside spot."); });
pm.test("Already reviewed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("This booking has already been reviewed"));

item.name: List reviews of an unknown campground -> 404
Campground detail shows reviews and rating

exec: pm.test("Has reviews with the reviewer name", () => { pm.expect(d.reviews).to.be.an("array"); const mine = d.reviews.find(x => x._id === pm.environment.get("reviewId")); pm.expect(mine).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(mine.user.name).to.eql("User One"); });
pm.test("Average rating and count are calculated", () => { pm.expect(d.averageRating).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.ratingCount).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Campground detail shows the seeded review

exec: pm.test("Seeded 5-star review is shown", () => { pm.expect(d.reviews.length).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(d.reviews[0].rating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(d.averageRating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(d.ratingCount).to.eql(1); });

item.name: User1 update own review with rating 9 -> 400

exec: pm.test("Rating and comment changed", () => { pm.expect(d.rating).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.comment).to.eql("Changed my mind, it was noisy."); });

item.name: Deleted review is gone from the campground list
Campground rating is reset after the delete

exec: pm.test("No reviews left", () => { pm.expect(d.reviews.length).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.ratingCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.averageRating).to.eql(0); });
